title: CIA-funded psychological conditioning at a Montreal institute

tellings.quote: massive psychological conditioning on undergone in Montreal Canada for instance um at an institute there that was funded by CIA for a long time.

plain: At an institute in Montreal, Canada, people are said to have undergone "massive psychological conditioning" while the place was funded for a long time by the CIA, the US spy agency, in the 1950s and 60s. The researcher Peter Levenda brings this up in passing as an example and names no source for it, though the story is linked to a man named Ewen Cameron. If true, it would mean an American intelligence agency was paying for efforts to reshape people's minds on foreign soil.
